description: Scrape a web page and return its raw HTML via ScrapingAnt (headless-browser rendering + rotating proxies). Handles JS-heavy sites and anti-bot pages. Example: scrapingant_scrape({ url: "https://example.com", browser: true, _apiKey: "your-key" })

_apiKey.description: Your ScrapingAnt API key. Sign up free at https://app.scrapingant.com/signup

browser.description: Render the page in a headless browser (executes JavaScript). Default true. Set false for a faster raw HTTP fetch of static pages.

js_snippet.description: Custom JavaScript to run in the page after load (plain JS — this pack base64-encodes it for you). Only applies when browser rendering is on.

proxy_country.description: Two-letter ISO country code for the proxy exit location, e.g. "US", "GB", "DE".

proxy_type.description: Proxy pool to use: "datacenter" (default, cheaper) or "residential" (harder to block).

url.description: The absolute URL of the page to scrape, e.g. "https://example.com/products"

wait_for_selector.description: CSS selector to wait for before returning (e.g. ".price"). Only applies when browser rendering is on.

name: scrapingant_scrape
title: Scrapingant Scrape
